messages:
maria: FYI staging docs build failing after migration. Linkcheck shows anchor 404s on localized pages and a few images not found.
jon: yeah I hit this locally too. Looks like our mdx slug behavior changed and some unicode headings get raw unicode ids.
kevin: also some image filenames with accents/unicode are being URL-encoded and the CDN path differs from what the site references.
lina: example from linkcheck: /zh/guide/#安装 -> HTML has id=\"安装\" but in-page links were slugified as an-zhuang (pinyin). mismatch.
sam: do we prefer ascii slug fallbacks or preserve unicode ids and update hrefs?
maria: short term: ascii-fallback slugify so anchors are stable across locales and CI. long term: document naming conventions for localized assets.
jon: I can add a tiny docusaurus markdown slugify hook. draft snippet:
```
const slugify = require('slugify');
module.exports = {
  markdown: {
    slugify: s => slugify(s, { lower: true, remove: /[^\w\s-]/g })
  }
};
```
kevin: for assets I made a quick mapping script but prefer deterministic JS so CI is consistent.
lina: agreed, iconv-based hacks differ by OS. jon, include an assets-manifest generator that maps original -> ascii-fallback names.
jon: will do. I'll add tests: one chinese heading, one accented filename mapping.
sam: once PR is up, run linkcheck on staging and smoke test zh/fr builds.
docs-ci: linkcheck queued for branch fix/slugify-assets. logs will post here.
kevin: local verify with jon's branch: anchors now become `#an-zhuang` which matches transformed hrefs.
maria: merged branch into hotfix and adjusted manifest output `assets-manifest.json` for redirects.
docs-ci: linkcheck passed on staging: 0 anchor failures, 0 missing assets. deploy preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/ (job 2623)
jon: I'll add a short migration note in the docs repo about ascii filename policy for localized assets.
maria: can someone add a blurb to CONTRIBUTING.md about ascii-fallback policy? sam?
sam: on it.
kevin: added tools/slug-check.js in PR that finds headings whose hrefs/id differ; handy for maintainers.
maria: great. closing thread. ping if anything regresses.
_meta: generated: slack thread about fixing unicode anchors and asset filenames after docs migration
